family: cell_id: sha256 prefix of the factor vector. One family = one point in the grammar.

index_row.cell: the full factor vector (one key per grammar factor)
index_row.derived: computed tags: endogenous, spontaneity_test, constant_kind, has_task, moat, seeded_instrument
index_row.control_of: run_id this run is the matched control of, if any
index_row.control_axis: the single factor flipped to make this control
index_row.parent_run: run_id this run was promoted from, if any
index_row.reason: why the scheduler allocated this run
index_row.interest: scalar the producer was updated with
index_row.voided: true if a critical flag means this run cannot support a reproduction claim
index_row.paths: relative paths to the per-run artefacts

note: Rows are append-only. A run is never rewritten; a rerun is a new run_id with parent_run set.
